player_prompt.intro:
I nih hi {color} in a game of Breakthrough-ah i chawm ⵛⵛ e. I move {direction} on an {board_size}x{board_size} board.
In i turn-ah hian i piece pakhat chauh kha a forward emaw diagonally forward-in a kal thei.
I piece chuan diagonally-in a kal thei a, mahse, opponent piece a awm a ni a, a awmna diagonal square-ah chauh a lut thei.
I square-a opponent piece awmna-ah i luh chuan i capture ang a, opponent piece chu board atangin a ral leh a ni.
UCI-like notation i hman ang, e.g. [a2a3] i hman ang a, a2 atangin a3 ah a kal ang.
* 'a' hi leftmost column a ni, '1' hi bottom row (White perspective-in a). 
* Black's home row chu top row (row 8, 8x8 ah) a ni a, White's home row chu bottom row (row 1, 8x8 ah) a ni.
I piece i opponent home row thleng thei chu a chak ⵛⵛ e. I piece zawng zawng capture a nih chuan i hneh loh ang.

outcome.black_reached: Black-in White home row a thleng ta.
